title: AHB Address/Data Pipeline Ownership
description: Three zero-wait SINGLE transfers make address/data overlap explicit: each data phase belongs to the address accepted one cycle earlier.

annotations.message: Transfer 1 has only an address phase. Its data cannot complete until the following cycle.
Address A2 overlaps Data D1. HWDATA D_60 belongs to the earlier 0x60 address, not the currently visible 0x70 address.
Address A3 overlaps Data D2. A monitor must queue accepted address/control so it attributes D_70 correctly.
Data D3 completes after the address stream has gone IDLE. The pipeline drains one cycle after the final address.
